tools.name: agora_catalog
tools.description: Free. Lists AGORA Omega paid tools, prices (USDC via x402) and networks.

tools.name: agora_company_search
tools.description: Official French company data (SIRENE/RNE), cleaned: identity, geolocated HQ, NACE code, headcount, latest revenue and net income. Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402.

tools.name: agora_counterparty_check
tools.description: Counterparty check before paying a platform or crypto provider: French AMF blacklists, ESMA MiCA register (authorised and non-compliant CASPs), sanctions lists (EU, UN Security Council, US OFAC SDN). Official public data, refreshed daily. Price: $0.08 USDC per call, paid with x402.

tools.name: agora_verify_deliverable
tools.description: Independent verifier agent: quality score from 0 to 100, doubtful claims and a verdict (valider = accept, corriger = fix, rejeter = reject). Check another agent's work before paying for it. Price: $0.05 USDC per call, paid with x402.

tools.name: agora_supplier_audit
tools.description: Supplier due-diligence mission (orchestrated): official French company registry + AMF blacklists + ESMA MiCA register + EU/UN/OFAC sanctions, merged into one pay / verify / do-not-pay decision with confidence score. Run it before paying a supplier or platform. Price: $0.25 USDC per call, paid with x

tools.name: agora_ai_act_check
tools.description: EU AI Act art. 50 transparency check: is an AI disclosure required, is it present, plus the disclosure text and machine-readable metadata to add. Price: $0.02 USDC per call, paid with x402.
